svg.aria-label: Map of St Thomas's journeys by tradition: from Galilee overland through Parthia to Taxila and the kingdom of Gondophares, or by sea on the monsoon winds from the Red Sea to Muziris in Kerala in AD 52, overland to Mylapore where he was martyred in AD 72, and the relics carried to Edessa, Chios and Ortona
svg.title: Map of St Thomas's journeys by tradition: from Galilee overland through Parthia to Taxila and the kingdom of Gondophares, or by sea on the monsoon winds from the Red Sea to Muziris in Kerala in AD 52, overland to Mylapore where he was martyred in AD 72, and the relics carried to Edessa, Chios and Ortona

g.text: Overland east, as in the Acts of Thomas
By sea on the monsoon, as Kerala remembers
Overland across south India to Mylapore
